title: Irish Lamb Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish made with lamb, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe combines the rich flavors of lamb with the comfort of a traditional Irish pilaf.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, thyme, and rosemary to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
